steps.name: Goal
steps.rule: Set one checkable end state, so a long thread needs no prompt each turn.

steps.rule: A goal keeps the thread working until its condition is met or judged impossible.

steps.rule: Count the permission prompts each thread shows.

steps.name: Auto mode
steps.rule: Auto mode rules in user settings name trusted destinations, so routine calls raise no prompt.
